description: An expander for BaBum adding CV control of its four length settings and of its kick, snare and FX drive; it goes immediately to the right of BaBum

inputs.text: Added to BaBum's kick length knob, one knob unit per volt
Added to BaBum's snare length knob, one knob unit per volt
Added to BaBum's hi-hat length knob, one knob unit per volt, which sets both the closed and the open hi-hat
Added to BaBum's FX length knob, one knob unit per volt
Added to BaBum's kick drive knob, one knob unit per volt, with the total clamped to 1 to 10
Added to BaBum's snare drive knob, one knob unit per volt, with the total clamped to 1 to 10
Added to BaBum's FX drive knob, one knob unit per volt, with the total clamped to 1 to 10; the FX knob reads as far as 49 but the clamp stops the drive at 10

notes: with no BaBum immediately to its left this module does nothing at all
there is no hi-hat drive jack here, because BaBum has no hi-hat drive control
a length total is clamped to the knob's own 0.001 to 5 range, so a length knob already at 5 cannot be pushed any further

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0.001 to 5V.
